id: title:Gilbert09:don t crash repartition detection on a persistent app db blip

review.posthog_relevance: Repartition controller failure handling and warehouse connection degradation response
review.reason: Adds exception handling for OperationalError and InterfaceError in warehouse query, returning False and calling capture_exception. This could help PostHog by recording warehouse connection failures rather than crashing, though the chunk lacks the actual retry implementation and complete execution path, preventing a higher tier.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include implementation of actual retry or complete execution path; score relies only on exception handling and test, not broader systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the actual retry or the complete execution path, only the exception handling and a test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds exception handling for OperationalError and InterfaceError in the database query, returning False and calling capture_exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Repartition controller checks warehouse connection; if DB is degraded, it records the failure and disables the feature rather than crashing.
